effects.name: Star Volley
effects.notes: Three spinning stars with dithered streaks; loop, move it with the engine.

effects.name: Impact Burst
effects.notes: The default hit: white frame 0, 8-point star, ring, rays, sparks cooling.

effects.name: Shock Ring
effects.notes: Ground shockwave: three squashed rings leave the caster's feet (roar / stomp).

effects.name: Fire Ball
effects.notes: Hot white core, flame puffs that cool down the ramp along the trail.

effects.name: Fire Burst
effects.notes: Flash, puff cluster expands, cools to dark red and rises; embers fall.

effects.name: Flame Pillar
effects.notes: Column erupts from a ground glow, overshoots, holds, collapses.

effects.name: Flame Aura
effects.notes: Rising flame tongues around the unit; ground ring pulse.

effects.name: Water Jet
effects.notes: Charge 6f, shoots across in 3f, wavy body holds 8f, thins out.

effects.name: Bubble Shot
effects.notes: Glossy orb shedding ring bubbles.

effects.name: Water Splash
effects.notes: Crown splash, droplets on gravity arcs, flat ripple rings.

effects.name: Whirlpool
effects.notes: Stacked squashed rings spiralling up with orbiting droplets.

effects.name: Leaf Volley
effects.notes: Three tumbling two-tone leaves.

effects.name: Petal Burst
effects.notes: Green flash, leaves burst out and drift down.

effects.name: Leaf Spiral
effects.notes: Tornado of rings with orbiting leaves (spiral-ring language from the reference clips).

effects.name: Spark Ball
effects.notes: Yellow orb with a jittering bolt tail, redrawn every frame.

effects.name: Thunder Strike
effects.notes: 1 pre-strike frame, bolt flickers 4 + 2 frames, ground ring.

effects.name: Static Aura
effects.notes: Crackling sparks climbing the unit; flicker by skipping beats.

effects.name: Ice Shards
effects.notes: Three faceted shards, light side up, white tips.

effects.name: Ice Beam
effects.notes: Pale beam with crystals budding off both edges.

effects.name: Frost Shatter
effects.notes: Crystal fragments fly and fall; ring breaks into arcs.

effects.name: Blizzard Field
effects.notes: Diagonal snow over a frosted ground ellipse with wind streaks.

effects.name: Force Wave
effects.notes: Thick arcs pushed forward from the fist.

effects.name: Power Hit
effects.notes: Wide 8-point star, 12 rays: the heavy punch.

effects.name: Power Aura
effects.notes: Fast vertical speed-lines rising (power-up).

effects.name: Sludge Glob
effects.notes: Heavy glob dripping blobs that fall away.

effects.name: Toxic Splash
effects.notes: The splash archetype in purple; reads as goo.

effects.name: Poison Cloud
effects.notes: Lumpy dithered gas that churns; bubbles pop at the rim.

effects.name: Mud Ball
effects.notes: Earth orb with a dust trail.

effects.name: Quake Cracks
effects.notes: Cracks race out, rocks heave, dust; ground layer under units.

effects.name: Dust Burst
effects.notes: Chunks bounce, dust rolls outward.

effects.name: Air Blade
effects.notes: Crescent of wind with streaks behind.

effects.name: Gust Burst
effects.notes: Airy hit: no star, ring and rays only.

effects.name: Tornado
effects.notes: Broken rings spiralling up with wind ticks.

effects.name: Psy Beam
effects.notes: Pink beam with rings travelling along it.

effects.name: Psy Burst
effects.notes: Concentric rings blow outwards from the target.

effects.name: Mind Field
effects.notes: Ground rings pulsing under the unit (status-room / mind control).

effects.name: Buzz Wave
effects.notes: Thin sound arcs.

effects.name: Sting Volley
effects.notes: Three needles in formation.

effects.name: Sting Hit
effects.notes: Small sharp hit: 4 rays.

effects.name: Swarm
effects.notes: Tiny bugs on noisy orbits with wing flicker.

effects.name: Boulder Throw
effects.notes: Faceted rock tumbling in 8 steps with an outline, dust trail.

effects.name: Rock Smash
effects.notes: Heavy chunks bounce twice.

effects.name: Stone Spikes
effects.notes: Spikes stab up left to right, hold, sink.

effects.name: Shadow Orb
effects.notes: Dark orb with a smoky, dithered tail.

effects.name: Hex Burst
effects.notes: Dark core, purple rings.

effects.name: Spirit Wisps
effects.notes: Wisps with dithered tails drift up.

effects.name: Dragon Beam
effects.notes: Thick blue-teal beam with a white helix (beam language from the reference clips).

effects.name: Dragon Burst
effects.notes: The explosion archetype in cold colours.

effects.name: Dragon Aura
effects.notes: Blue flame tongues.

effects.name: Night Claw
effects.notes: Three diagonal rakes, white edge cools to plum.

effects.name: Dark Pulse
effects.notes: Thick dark rings radiate from a black core.

effects.name: Dark Orb
effects.notes: Black-plum orb with a tilted ring.

effects.name: Steel Beam
effects.notes: Silver beam with a white helix.

effects.name: Metal Spark
effects.notes: Clang: many sparks that arc down.

effects.name: Iron Spikes
effects.notes: Polished spikes rise in sequence.

effects.name: Steel Slash
effects.notes: Single crescent sweep, two-frame whip.

effects.name: Moon Orb
effects.notes: Pink orb leaving twinkling sparkles.

effects.name: Sparkle Burst
effects.notes: Hearts and stars fly out of a soft star.

effects.name: Fairy Ring
effects.notes: Sparkles rise inside a pink ground ring.

effects.name: Hit Spark
effects.notes: Smallest hit, 300 ms: use on every contact.

effects.name: Critical Hit
effects.notes: Two-beat crit: white block, jagged starburst, broken ring, long rays.

effects.name: Crit Cut-in
effects.notes: Opaque screen plate with radial speed lines for 4-6 frames on crits and K.O.s (reference clips).

effects.name: Miss
effects.notes: After-images slide off and MISS pops.

effects.name: Shield Dome
effects.notes: Hex-lattice dome with a sweeping highlight.

effects.name: Heal
effects.notes: Plus signs and sparkles rise; soft ring pulse.

effects.name: Stat Up
effects.notes: Warm arrows stream up.

effects.name: Stat Down
effects.notes: Cold arrows sink.

effects.name: Burn
effects.notes: Small flames lick up the body.

effects.name: Poison
effects.notes: Bubbles rise and pop.

effects.name: Paralysis
effects.notes: Random sparks with an off-beat every third frame.

effects.name: Sleep
effects.notes: Z letters drift up and grow.

effects.name: Freeze
effects.notes: Ice crust with a glint sweeping across.

effects.name: Confusion
effects.notes: Three stars orbit above the head, front ones bigger.

effects.name: Faint Vanish
effects.notes: Dust ring and rising motes; play over the faint unit animation.

effects.name: Level Up
effects.notes: Gold column, sparkles, chevron and LV UP stamp.

effects.name: Evolve Glow
effects.notes: Silhouette blinks white in quickening beats, then a flash hides the swap.

effects.name: Recall Beam
effects.notes: Thin red beam appears at full length; unit shrinks into it.

effects.name: Send-out Burst
effects.notes: Floor flash ring and sparkles as a unit appears.

effects.name: Charge Up
effects.notes: Generic wind-up: particles stream into a pulsing core.

effects.name: Idle Bob
effects.notes: Squash/stretch bob, blink on frame 2.

effects.name: Attack Lunge
effects.notes: Lean back 3f, dash 2f with after-image, hold 2f, return.

effects.name: Hit Recoil
effects.notes: 2 white frames, knockback 7px with jitter, 2 blinks, settle.

effects.name: Faint
effects.notes: Stagger, flatten, dither out.
